note: Bosnia and Herzegovina: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days (in 180 for most), Russia and Ukraine 30 in 60. Everyone else needs a visa (holders of Schengen, Cypriot, Irish, Monégasque or US multiple-entry visas may enter for 30 days: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.
